basis.source: CAWG Delegated Creator Taskforce discussions, 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-26
basis.source_scope: Informative engineering mapping of discussion propositions; unpublished materials are not prerequisites for independently reproducing the local tests. This mapping does not imply adopted requirements.
basis.authority: informative repository-local mapping; not CAWG/TRQP normative conformance
basis.feasibility_note: Experimental independent implementation may proceed without CAWG adoption; status still measures satisfaction of the taskforce's upstream-defined semantic contract.

status_definitions.represented: Directly supported by inspected repository evidence, not an upstream normative adoption claim.
status_definitions.partial: Related capability or guidance exists, but the specific taskforce proposition is not fully implemented or evidenced.
status_definitions.missing: The reviewed evidence does not establish the requirement.
status_definitions.external: Action lies outside verifier ownership; taskforce or other authority must act.

requirements.title: Use-case-first elicitation
requirements.gap: Walkthrough portfolio and agent archetypes exist; the five taskforce creative worlds and taskforce-approved stories are not established.

requirements.title: Signing-time delegation statement; agreement and rights linked, not embedded
requirements.gap: Temporal validity and authority evidence are described, but a CAWG manifest binding and linked consent/rights contract are not established by these artifacts.

requirements.title: Three coverage states: unverified, delegator-covered, credential-backed
requirements.gap: Existing non-positive verifier outcomes are not equivalent to the proposed taskforce three-tier coverage semantics. A provisional, expressly non-normative experimental analogue is now implemented separately.

requirements.title: Bounded chain depth and duration with original-party traceability
requirements.gap: Delegation tuple includes depth, temporal validity, and principal; no taskforce-established limit, chain representation, or root-consent evidence requirement is demonstrated.

requirements.title: Claim generator as witnessing third signer with rejection capability
requirements.gap: Agent roles are discussed, but generator-as-third-signer and enforceable rejection obligations are not established by this repository evidence. A provisional, expressly non-normative experimental analogue is now implemented separately.

requirements.title: CAWG-specific narrower TRQP profile
requirements.gap: Implementation profiles constrain operational verification; they do not constitute a CAWG-authorized domain semantic TRQP profile.

requirements.title: Industry survey on costs of unverified authority
requirements.gap: Survey administration and adoption evidence are taskforce activities, not reference-verifier behavior.

requirements.title: Human-to-human scoped delegation
requirements.gap: Human manager delegated authority is modeled in locally simulated fixtures; trust, verified signer binding and independently authoritative grant are not established.

requirements.title: Self-declared and anonymous-but-unique subject evidence
requirements.gap: Self-declaration and claimed uniqueness are represented without asserting uniqueness proof or civil identity verification.

requirements.title: Optional issuer-neutral creator vouching
requirements.gap: Professional vouching can be represented as untrusted claims; issuer recognition, credential trust and revocation remain unsupported.

requirements.title: Signature integrity separate from organizational binding and authority to delegate
requirements.gap: Local cryptographic statement integrity can be verified; external subject, enterprise, scope and signing-authority checks remain indeterminate.

requirements.title: CAWG endorsement assertion relation to delegated creator representation
requirements.gap: Extension versus separate assertion is upstream-dependent; repository experiments have no authority to decide the CAWG representation.
